answer.rationale: Broadly deploy the proven shortened/simplified onboarding path for SMB accounts. It improved completion, reduced time-to-value, and increased 30-day retention, supporting sustainable qualified revenue rather than merely offsetting competitor pricing with lower-quality acquisition. Avoid promotional pricing: the recovered targeted-discount experiment lifted signup and qualified revenue but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, directly conflicting with the long-term objective. Effects under the competitor's new price cut remain uncertain, so monitor SMB conversion, activation, retention, and qualified revenue closely.
